question:
Select the combination of signs that when sequentially placed in the given blanks will make the equation correct.

12_4_3_24
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b968da625e3936f9364a60f4ec3bdc8f1d4b1d1db9850270d1f3b4f0822dfd51.png] 

Option 1) : ÷, × and =

Given equation : 12_4_3_24

After inserting the mathematical operators in given equation the equation is as follows : 12 ÷ 4 × 3 = 24

⇒ __**12 ÷ 4**__ × 3 = 24

⇒ __**3 × 3**__ = 24

⇒ 9 ≠ 24
